mapper.select: SELECT distinct SEC_ACCT_ID id, SEC_ACCT_NAME name from STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO

SELECT t.TRADE_ID tradeId,/**交易编号**/ null outTradeId, /*外部成交编号*/ deal.BOOKSET_ID prodId,/**金融产品代码**/ bok.BOOKSET_NAME prodName,/**金融产品名称**/ zc.FINPROD_MARKET_ID secId, /**资产代码**/ zc.FINPROD_ABBR secAbbr,/**资产简称**/ t.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket,/**交易场所**/ null secManageAcctId,/**证券账户**/ t.PS ps,/**交易方向**/ t.TRADE_DATE tradeDate,/**交易日**/ t.SETTLE_DATE settdateDate,/**交割日期**/ stl.SETTLE_DATE fundSettleDate,/**资金交收日**/ t.INV_AIM invAim,/**会计分类**/ t.CHL_ID chlId,/**通道代码**/ t.SHARE_AMT dealNum,/**成交数量**/ t.FPRICE_AMT fpriceAmt,/**全价总额**/ t.INT_AMT intAmt,/**应收利息总额**/ t.CPRICE_AMT cpriceAmt,/**净价总额**/ t.UNIT_CPRICE cprice,/**净价**/ CASE WHEN ttfd.FEE_TYPE = 'B01' THEN ttfd.FEE_AMT ELSE 0 END as brokerage,/**经手费**/ CASE WHEN ttfd.FEE_TYPE = 'B07' THEN ttfd.FEE_AMT ELSE 0 END as stlAmt,/**结算费**/ CASE WHEN ttfd.FEE_TYPE = 'B05' THEN ttfd.FEE_AMT ELSE 0 END as commission,/**佣金**/ CASE WHEN ttfd.FEE_TYPE = 'B06' THEN ttfd.FEE_AMT ELSE 0 END as dealFeeAmt,/**交易手续费**/ CASE WHEN ttfd.FEE_TYPE = 'B08' THEN ttfd.FEE_AMT ELSE 0 END as stlFeeAmt,/**结算手续费**/ CASE WHEN ttfd.FEE_TYPE = 'B99' THEN ttfd.FEE_AMT ELSE 0 END as otherAmt,/**其他应付费用**/ null bondAmt,/**保证金**/ stl.SETTLE_AMT settleAmt,/**结算金额**/ t.TRADE_AMT bTradeAmt,/**本币交易金额**/ stl.MY_ACCT_NO myAcctNo/**资金账户**/ FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = t.finprod_id LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = t.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bok on bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN STL_ORDERS stl ON stl.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND stl.BUSI_TYPE ='02' LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ttfd ON ttfd.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID where t.BUSI_TYPE ='02' and t.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}
